title: Open Trestle Provider Data Constraints v1
description: Canonical interchange shape for provider data constraints. Validation does not prove classification accuracy, policy authority, or provider behavior.

allowed_provider_zones.description: No provider zone is permitted when this array is empty; routing must deny the request. Array order has no meaning.

content_logging_allowed.description: False requires an effective no-content-logging guarantee. True removes content logging as a disqualifier but does not require or prove logging.
